records.title: CHICAGO AREA SIAM STUDENT CONFERENCE
records.summary: A two-day regional gathering bringing students and researchers together for national-laboratory visits, talks, scientific discussion, new connections, and a little bowling and symphony.
records.history: The 2024 Chicago Area SIAM Student Conference was held jointly with the SPS Zone 9 Meeting and brought together students from more than ten universities. Day 1 sent attendees to Fermilab and Argonne National Laboratory before everyone reconvened for dinner and an evening at The Bog. Day 2 continued at Illinois Tech with talks and discussion spanning applied mathematics, physics, machine learning, uncertainty quantification, and scientific computing, before concluding at the Chicago Symphony Orchestra.

program.title: PUTTING MATH AT THE FOUNDATIONS OF MACHINE LEARNING
program.speaker: Carlo Graziani
program.description: A discussion of the mathematical foundations of machine learning, its historical development, and challenges including hallucination and explainability.

program.title: REGIONAL STUDENT LUNCH
program.description: Lunch was organized to encourage students to meet researchers and students from institutions across the region and continue conversations about greater collaboration among Chicagoland students.

program.speaker: Chris Quigg
program.description: A discussion of Emmy Noether, conservation laws, symmetry, and the continuing significance of Noether's theorems in physics.

program.title: THE PRESENT & FUTURE OF MATH, PHYSICS, AND ML

program.speaker: Robert S. Eisenberg
